meta.name: learn
meta.description: Distill a reusable skill from anything — a directory, a URL, pasted notes, or what you just did together — or refine an existing skill with new learnings. Use when the user says '/learn', 'learn this', 'turn this into a skill', 'capture this workflow', 'make a skill from <source>', or 'improve/update the <name> skill'. Produces or updates a .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md authored to NanoClaw's skill guidelines. (This CREATES or REFINES a skill from a source; it does not install existing skills from a registry.)

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从任何来源提炼或改进可复用的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把操作流程固化为可复用的技能
copy.tagline_en: Distill or refine a reusable skill from any source
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn workflows into reusable skills

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 能把一个来源——目录、URL、贴进来的笔记,或你们刚在对话里做的事——提炼成可复用的技能,产出或就地更新 .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md。它只用现有工具,是指令型技能。
howto.when: 当你说 “/learn”、“learn this”、“turn this into a skill” 等,或想改进某个已有技能时触发。它创建或就地更新技能,不安装注册表里的现成技能。

say.note: 把这次对话的流程提炼成新技能
读取该目录并生成对应技能

say.text: 更新 wow-on-steam-deck 这个技能
say.note: 就地更新已有技能,而非整篇重写

howto.what_en: Installs an instruction-only skill that distills a directory, URL, pasted notes, or the current conversation into a reusable skill, writing or updating .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say '/learn', 'learn this', 'turn this into a skill', or similar, or ask to improve an existing skill. It creates or refines skills; it does not install existing ones.

say_en.note: Distills this conversation into a new skill
Reads that directory and builds a skill from it
Refines that skill in place, not a rewrite
